title: Text
sub: Type that moves as it lands.

items.how: Lights the words of each group in turn.
The old value is struck through, then flips away.
A width wave runs out from the middle letter.
Sizes the line to its measure, then rises in.

knob.line: grow: true. It may grow to fill.

items.how: Traces each outline in turn, then fills it.

knob.line: stroke: accent. The tracing line in colour.

items.how: A marker sweeps behind the words as they fade in.
One word at a time, each replacing the last.

knob.line: d: 90 px. Each word rises further.

items.how: A fill rises inside outlined letters, led by an edge.

knob.line: fill: accent. It fills with colour.

items.how: Letters resolve left to right out of shuffling noise.
Departure-board tiles flip through letters and land in turn.

knob.line: flips: 14. The last tile spins longer.
